{{recipe}}

'''''Tembleque''''' is a thickened coconut pudding originating from Puerto Rico.

==Ingredients==

* 1 can (16 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) of [[Cookbook:Coconut Milk|coconut milk]] 
* 1 can (16 oz) of [[Cookbook:Coconut Cream|coconut cream]] 
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy whipping cream]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]] or [[Cookbook:Rice Flour|rice flour]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Orange Flower Water|orange blossom water]] (optional)
* ¾ cup white [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* Ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]] for garnish

==Procedure==

# Put sugar, coconut milk, coconut cream, and. salt, into a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. Cook until sugar devolves and the milk starts to [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]]. 
# Mix 3 tablespoons or more of cold heavy whipping cream into the corn starch. [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] until all the cornstarch is diluted but still thick. You want a smooth thick paste with no lumps. 
#  When milk starts to simmer, add the remaining heavy whipping cream and cornstarch mixture into the saucepan.
# Keep the heat on low and stir constantly until the pudding thickens.
# Pour into pudding cups or small bowls.
# Cool in the fridge for 2 hours.
# To serve, flip the pudding bowls onto a plate to remove the pudding, then sprinkle cinnamon on top.
